items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: With Jack Carroll. Back in Jack Carroll. See, because Jack Carroll was what we called a real ball house band.

ctx.x: With Jack Carroll. Back in Jack Carroll. See, because Jack Carroll was what we called a real ball house band. We would call it a real ball house band. Then in the later years, then they started to call it a jazz. But it was real what you call real old wild, just what you make up your own song.
